thread:
alicia: quick heads-up — deploybot reported a 'migration-stutter' during the first canary batch for tenant backfill 2026-03-21 22:00 window. low traffic but saw lock churn :eyes:

deploybot: Canary job cj-58 started
deploybot: Batch 1/20 processed, latency spike on DB locks: 1.2s -> 5.8s for 3 queries. 2 transient failures, auto-retry triggered

pradeep: logs? which queries

alicia: here's the minimal repro from the job log:
```
UPDATE tenant_profiles SET flags = flags | 1 WHERE flags IS NULL LIMIT 1000;
-- backfill throttle=300ms batch_size=100
```

maria: hmm that UPDATE pattern will touch hot rows on shard-3. can we reduce batch_size and add a sleep? also consider pk-range split

sam: recommended runtime change: batch_size=50, throttle=500ms. we can rerun batch 1-3. anyone object to continuing with that config and a holdpoint after batch 5?

alicia: +1 for adjusted config. set holdpoint at batch 5, manual ack to proceed. we should pin the migration binary to 3.4.1 so rollback is predictable.

deploybot: Action: update job cj-58 config -> batch_size=50 throttle_ms=500. Will continue. Next holdpoint => batch 5

pradeep: add a quick revert command in the runbook pls

alicia: rollback command pasted to runbook:
```
# stop migration
deploybot cancel cj-58
# revert schema change (safe path)
psql -h prod -d rdw -c "ALTER TABLE tenant_profiles DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS tmp_flags_v2;"
```

oncall-bot: alert: lock_conflicts spike on db-host-12 during cj-58 window. currently 4xx/5xx = 0, but waitlisted locks=18

maria: if waitlisted locks > 25 we stop automatically. set alert threshold to 25 and escalation to eng-oncall.

sam: acknowledged. I'll monitor dashboards and pin a rollback hold if it trends.

alicia: ok proceeding with adjusted config. will post a follow-up once batch 5 holdpoint reached. :thumbsup:

pradeep: copy — watching logs

deploybot: Canary job cj-58 progressed: reached holdpoint at batch 5. awaiting manual ack to continue.

alicia: manual ack issued. continuing but team on standby. release notes link: https://redwood.internal/releases/2026-03-21/mig-tenant-flags

sam: monitoring 1m p95 and lock queue; call if any > threshold

maria: remember to mark migration pinned version=3.4.1 in the release notes + customer impact: none expected

alicia: thanks — closing thread after final checkin
